name: The Caravan Road
summary: In Booty Bay, the search for Velinde Starsong turns north toward Darkshire. Caravaneer Ruzzgot remembers the missing night elf priestess traveling with his caravan through Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: A Priestess in the Jungle
sections.body: Caravaneer Ruzzgot remembers Velinde Starsong as a passenger on his caravan. The search for the missing night elf priestess has brought you from Ashenvale to Booty Bay, at the southern edge of Stranglethorn Vale. She traveled with his caravan through the jungle, an unusual journey for a night elf priestess.

sections.title: North to Darkshire
sections.body: Ruzzgot says he and Velinde parted ways as they traveled north through Stranglethorn Vale. She set out toward Duskwood, and her trail leads to Darkshire. Clerk Daltry keeps the town's records, including the names of unfamiliar travelers who enter. His ledger may hold the next clue to Velinde's whereabouts.

faq.answer: Velinde Starsong is a night elf priestess of Elune who left her homeland in Kalimdor under mysterious circumstances. Her disappearance led to a search across the continents, following her trail from Ashenvale through the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Why was Velinde traveling with a caravan?
faq.answer: Velinde traveled through goblin territory with Caravaneer Ruzzgot's shipping outfit. She hired passage for the dangerous journey north through Stranglethorn Vale.
Clerk Daltry is Darkshire's town clerk and archivist in Duskwood. He records outsiders and visitors amid the strange occurrences and threats in the region.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead after Darkshire?
faq.answer: After you consult Clerk Daltry's records, he directs you to Jonathan Carevin. Speaking with Jonathan begins the search into Velinde's stay in Duskwood through his family.

faq.q: Why is traveling from Booty Bay to Darkshire dangerous?
faq.answer: Stranglethorn Vale is home to predatory beasts, hostile troll tribes, and Bloodsail buccaneers. The journey north is dangerous, and travelers need to stay close to the main road.
The search began in Ashenvale, where night elf investigators noticed Velinde's unexplained departure with an artifact of great power. Clues pointed to a ship bound for the southern seas.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may share your kin's concern over Velinde Starsong, a Sentinel priestess of Elune whose secretive actions have taken her to the Eastern Kingdoms.
As an Alliance traveler, you carry news between neutral goblin ports and remote Alliance outposts such as Darkshire, linking places in a world fractured by recent wars.
